hook.line: Save this one website and you'll never need to build an AI agent yourself.
hook.visual: Founder in a shirt facing camera with a large green 'Prebuilt Agents' title card above his head and yellow-keyword captions.

beats.what: Screenshot of the agent list pops in above his head
Red arrow points to the stock portfolio analyst
Arrow on the multilingual voice agents
How to get them: the GitHub repo
Drop it into Claude or ChatGPT and ask how to install
Cut to closing: 'I'm Ben Gusberg, follow me'

why_it_works: 'Save this' as the first two words tells the viewer the video is a resource, which shows in 3,879 shares
Credentials in the first 7 s (founder, $4M raised) give a reason to trust the list
Screenshot plus red arrow above his head shows the exact item while he names it
weaknesses: One long shot (26.8 s) with no punch-ins; energy relies on hand gestures
Screenshots are tiny and unreadable at phone size
for_robert: Open with 'save this' and a big title card, then have Fred carry a small screenshot into frame and point at the item as Robert names it.
